label: Abandoned cart report
description: Emails the abandoned cart summary to the recipients listed in the Report Pilot app settings each time a report is generated.
subject: Abandoned carts: {{ period_label }} — {% assign rp_n = abandoned_count | round: 0 %}{% if rp_n < 0 %}-{% assign rp_n = rp_n | abs %}{% endif %}{% if rp_n >= 1000000 %}{{ rp_n | divided_by: 1000000 | floor }},{{ rp_n | divided_by: 1000 | floor | modulo: 1000 | prepend: "00" | slice: -3, 3 }},{{ rp_n | modulo: 1000 | prepend: "00" | slice: -3, 3 }}{% elsif rp_n >= 1000 %}{{ rp_n | divided_by: 1000 | floor }},{{ rp_n | modulo: 1000 | prepend: "00" | slice: -3, 3 }}{% else %}{{ rp_n }}{% endif %} abandoned, {% assign rp_n = recovered_count | round: 0 %}{% if rp_n < 0 %}-{% assign rp_n = rp_n | abs %}{% endif %}{% if rp_n >= 1000000 %}{{ rp_n | divided_by: 1000000 | floor }},{{ rp_n | divided_by: 1000 | floor | modulo: 1000 | prepend: "00" | slice: -3, 3 }},{{ rp_n | modulo: 1000 | prepend: "00" | slice: -3, 3 }}{% elsif rp_n >= 1000 %}{{ rp_n | divided_by: 1000 | floor }},{{ rp_n | modulo: 1000 | prepend: "00" | slice: -3, 3 }}{% else %}{{ rp_n }}{% endif %} recovered

fields.label: Intro line
fields.default: Here's what was left in carts.
